architecture: ImageNet ResNet50, 2048-to-512 linear projection, BN neck, 98-class identity classifier
sampling: Uniform distinct train composite IDs; random observation from each lifespan stratum, with replacement only for tracks shorter than K
triplet_negatives: same video, different composite identity; skip anchors without both valid positive and negative
checkpoint_selection: fixed last epoch 12 for representation baseline; no retrieval/test-based selection
scope: Strong fish-trained appearance baseline before CMUE/PLIM. RGB and causal IR use identical budgets and independent encoders. Final tracker configuration selection remains protocol dev HOTA/AssA/IDF1.
